title: Shroud of Turin dating tested later repair cloth
summary: Randall Carlson tells of Shroud of Turin dating tested later repair cloth, about 1980s-early 1990s testing at Turin, Italy, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there were several repair jobs that were done to it. And so you have se several pieces of cloth that were much younger than the original piece of cloth.

plain: A researcher named Randall Carlson talks about the Shroud of Turin, a linen cloth kept in Turin, Italy, that many believe wrapped the body of Jesus. Carlson says the cloth was repaired several times over the centuries, so some of its pieces are much younger than the original, and that the scientific dating done in the 1980s may have tested those later patches. If he is right, the original cloth could be far older than the tests suggested.
